# El Fortín

> A real estate investment in a boutique new building in Riba-roja de Túria, Valencia, in your name. 4% floor in the contract. Operations start August 2027.

El Fortín Construcciones y Patrimonio S.L. (CIF B22792923) is selling remaining apartments at Camino Valencia 31, 46190 Riba-roja de Túria, Valencia, Spain. Each buyer takes title (escritura) to a named apartment. All ten are run as one professionally managed building; rent is pooled. 4% minimum yearly return, net of the apartment sale price (valor público), in the contract; if operations fall short, the company pays the difference. 8% projected yearly return; the projection is not a promise. Construction is 25% complete. Operations start August 2027. Building licence Exp. 4497/2025/GEN, granted 20 October 2025. One-bedroom €236,000; two-bedroom €270,000, furniture and appliances included. Nine of ten apartments remain. Founder and operator: Uriel Nabel, who lives in Riba-roja.
